hero.description: Parents are their children's most important educators, but finding the right relationship with the digital world is complex. Edulogia helps make technology work for your family. We provide the guides, suggestions, and support needed to build healthy digital habits and leverage the best of what technology has to offer.

about.title: About me
about.intro: My name is Alfredo, and I am a father, a nerd, and an educator. I firmly believe that the digital world is a precious ally and a valid tool for our children's education, but I am equally convinced that it must be used with a LOT of awareness.
about.mission_description: Because we all know how difficult it is to find the right balance between the digital world, cell phone use, and healthy growth. Edulogia was created to respond to this daily challenge by providing parents and the entire educational community with the knowledge and tools to guide our children in a rapidly and constantly evolving digital landscape.
about.vision_description: With resources and guides on using cell phone Parental Controls to support a healthy dialogue between parents and children, and to better understand how to use digital tools to expand kids' horizons and stimulate their creativity.

resources.title: Resource Library
resources.description: Step-by-step guides and detailed tutorials to best configure cell phones and applications to help our children build healthy digital habits.
